email.subject: Fernhill Energy - Cloud Engineer hands-on lab
email.body:
Hi,

Thanks for your application for the Cloud Engineer role at Fernhill Energy.

Before we schedule interviews, we ask candidates to complete a hands-on lab: deploy a small web service with infrastructure as code and share the repository with us. The full instructions are in the attached PDF. There is no fixed deadline, but most candidates finish within a week.

Best regards,
Fernhill Energy Talent Team
